audit_items.proof_trace: Every `add_outflow` call first invokes `count_current_outflow`, which sums ALL vector slots whose stored `segment.index >= timestamp_index - len + 1` (i.e., every segment within the current sliding window), and asserts the cumulative total plus the new value does not exceed `outflow_limit`. Because operations at different segment time indices write to different vector slots and each new call re-reads all in-window slots, there is no path by which splitting operations across segment boundaries can avoid the cumulative check.
